name: suid-binary
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: plants a setuid-root binary (a copy of a shell by default) outside the system directories -- an instant root backdoor. Vars: DEST (required, absolute path); SRC (optional, default /bin/bash).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
: "${DEST:?DEST is required}"
src="${SRC:-/bin/bash}"
install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname -- "$DEST")"
cp -f "$src" "$DEST"
chmod 4755 "$DEST"
